= Setup

// In an included file the path of an interdocument xref is relative to
// the top-level document. Asciidoctor turns the first xref into an
// internal link (#ref-options) and the second into a dead link
// (reference.html#ref-options), because the master includes
// chapters/reference.adoc, not reference.adoc.

Good: xref:chapters/reference.adoc#ref-options[options].

Dead in the converted master: xref:reference.adoc#ref-options[options].

// Asciidoctor renders the xref below as the dead link
// setup.html#setup-notes: no setup.adoc lies next to index.adoc, only this
// file has the name. It reports none of the three xrefs.

[[setup-notes]]
Dead, no file at this path: xref:setup.adoc#setup-notes[notes].
